title: The graph of the zero map is the horizontal plane
statement: For all natural numbers n, l: span{graphPoint v (0 v) : v in R^n} = horizontalPlane n l, where 0 : R^n -> R^l is the zero continuous linear map and horizontalPlane n l = span{EuclideanSpace.single (Fin.castAdd l i) 1 : i < n}.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v ((0 : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) v)) = horizontalPlane n ℓ
